properties.Landslides:
1. Bank collapsing - Bank collapsing onto Dolosbage Road near the Cadet Office of Jinaraja School
2. Bank collapsing - Bank collapsing/ bank erosion of the canal behind Mr. Dhanesh Weerasekara's house
properties.NBRO Recommendation N/A:
Needs NBRO concern
Needs NBRO concern
properties.Proposed Measures:
It is appropriate to construct Concrete Retaining wall of L = 10 m, H = 3 m
It is advisable to construct the canal (L = 20 m, H = 1.5 m, W = 2.4 m) and a retaining wall (L = 30 m, H = 2.0 m). Also, to prevent bank erosion, it is advisable to pave available stones in the streams and plant trees such as Kumbuk, arica nut, bamboo in necessary places. Special attention should be paid to preventing the discharge of garbage into these streams and marking the boundaries of reservations lands.
